name: Rumi
role: Persian Sufi poet and jurist in Konya (1207–1273), author of the Mesnevi
summary: Rumi was a Sufi mystic and poet whose Mesnevi teaches divine love, faith and ethical conduct through tales. He held no office and set out no political programme, so his recorded positions on political statements are few.
